Was there a time for man when he was nothing that could be named?
We made man from a mixed drop, to test him. And We gave him ears and eyes.
We showed him the way. He can say thank you or not say thank you.
We made ready chains and rings and a blazing Fire for people who do not believe.
But the good people will drink from a cup that smells sweet.
It is a spring from which the servants of Allah drink. They make it flow where they want.
They keep their promises and fear a Day when its trouble spreads everywhere.
And they feed the poor, the child with no parents and the prisoner, because they love Him.
We only feed you for the sake of Allah. We want no pay and no thanks from you.
We fear a hard and sad Day from our Lord.
So Allah will keep them safe from the trouble of that Day, and give them a bright face and joy.
And He will give them a garden and silk as a reward for being patient.
They will rest on couches there. They will feel no hot sun and no cold.
Its shade will be close over them, and its fruit will hang low for them to reach.
Cups of silver and glasses of crystal will be passed around them.
Crystal that is made of silver. They measured them just right.
They will be given a cup to drink that is mixed with ginger.
A spring there is called Salsabil.
Boys who never grow old will go around them. If you see them, you would think they were scattered pearls.
Wherever you look, you will see joy and a great kingdom.
They will wear clothes of green silk and rich cloth. They will wear silver bracelets. And their Lord will give them a pure drink.
This is your reward. Your work was thanked.
It is We who sent down the Quran to you, little by little.
So be patient with what your Lord decides. And do not obey any sinner or anyone who says no to the truth.
And remember the name of your Lord in the morning and the evening.
And in part of the night bow down to Him, and praise Him for a long part of the night.
These people love this fast life and leave behind a heavy Day.
We made them and made them strong. When We want, We can replace them with others like them.
This is a reminder. So whoever wants to, can take a way to his Lord.
But you cannot want anything unless Allah wants. Allah is All-Knowing and Wise.
He takes into His kindness whoever He wants. But for the wrongdoers, He has made ready a painful punishment.
